Still weak: in the band the left column holds about 500px of empty black between the 12:17 and 12:25 notes (d-15-BAND745.png), and the phone only starts at y=570 under the headline so the top right is empty (d-13-BAND600.png).

Zodiak/Sentient/mono, tight tracking, left-aligned body. Band headline now sits on one line with the grey second tone separated (d-13-BAND600.png). Band dead gaps came down from 30vh margins but min-h-[70vh] steps still leave 360-500px voids (d-15-BAND745.png, m-14-BAND738.png on mobile). The statement's left edge is x=268 while the abstract card and every other block start at x=152 (d-01-statement.png). Strategy card footers are inconsistent: card 1 stacks chip above 'Read 3.1', the others put verdict and Read on one row (d-05-s3.png).

Recognisable identity at thumbnail size (sheet-d.png): newsprint, ink, one rust-amber, near-black band. Cream-to-Night cut now clears the header with a rule and 160px top padding (d-13-BAND600.png). Green and red appear only as meaning (chips, Urgent). Amber is still only a small accent in the band (times in #f08a5d, rail).

Eight restyled 21st.dev pieces held; strategy cards lost the repeated chip and the mono third voice (d-05-s3.png). Global :focus-visible rules exist in globals.css lines 64 and 70, but no capture shows focus, hover or pressed, so those are not credited.

No gradients, glows, pills or uppercase labels; copy is plain. Remaining small tells: mono 'One-minute price, illustration' label and mono times in the band repeat a data voice; hard-coded #f08a5d at PaperPage.tsx line 187 sits outside the tokens.

Hero sequence now plays in view and the reduced-motion fold is intact (desktop-fold-reduced.png). Pinned scrubbed phone with live counters is a real signature (d-14 to d-16). Held back: reduced-motion band and any pointer/hover state not captured; the band's step spacing makes the scrub feel slow.

390px (sheet-m.png): no horizontal scroll, hero fits, docked phone now has 'No alerts yet' text and never reads empty. Band text slides under the docked phone with a fade, which works, but 120-220px empty black gaps between paragraph and note remain (m-14-BAND738.png).

Both user-liked mechanisms now read in captures: Round's centred serif hero with the drawing rising (d-00-top.png) and the two-tone statement (d-01-statement.png, Ink lead then grey); Auxia's cream-to-dark band with a two-tone headline (d-13-BAND600.png). Section treatments differ (hero, statement, abstract card, specimen grid, Night band, conclusion). The band's strongest moment is diluted by long paragraphs and the empty left column.

mechanism_verdicts.auxia_cream_to_dark_band: Landed and cleaner: rule, header clearance, then the phone. The right half of the band's first screen is empty until the phone appears.
mechanism_verdicts.auxia_two_tone_headline: Landed. 'Your phone on 8 October.' on one line over a grey second tone with a gap.
